removed.name: Monzo Bank
removed.long_description:
YC has written a good overview of our business on their blog: https://blog.ycombinator.com/monzo-makes-money-work-for-everyone/

Our mission is to make money work for everyone. We are the UK's leading digital bank for individuals and businesses, reinventing the traditional banking industry one customer at a time. We're relentlessly mission driven and always put our customers first - from what products we chose to launch next to our transparency and use of simple language. With a Net Promoter Score of 70+, it shows. 

From our founding in 2015, we now have over 7 million customers in the UK (13% of UK adults) and are building out our team in the US. We've seen incredible organic growth, acquiring 150,000 customers / month in 2022, with 80% of this coming from word of mouth. Our weekly active user rate is ~60% and ~40% of our active users use us as their Main Bank account, showing that we are a product that is embedded in our users' daily lives. We've grown to ~2,450 staff (~400 of which make up the product/tech team), and are backed by YC, Stripe, Tencent, Mike Moritz, and others.

Internally, we encourage an open, collaborative, and inclusive working environment - we were voted the #1 startup where people in the UK want to work for the second year running in 2022. We contribute to open source software, and we continually engage with our wonderful community. We're hiring talented, creative problem-solvers to help us build the bank of the future. Join us!
removed.one_liner: A bank as smart as your phone.

long_description.before: Pibit.ai is an SF–based insurtech company reconstructing the art (and science) of commercial underwriting for carriers and MGAs. At the heart is the CURE™ platform, the industry’s only centralized underwriting risk environment fueled by agentic underwriting services that delivers decision-ready outcomes. It converts submissions into decisions by automating intake, triage, and data enrichment from documents and external sources while surfacing risk insights so you can win the right accounts faster, scale throughput, and reduce loss ratios. Backed by Y-Combinator, the proprietary platform serves dozens of clients across the US, enabling 85% faster underwriting, 32% increase in GWP per underwriter, and up to 700 basis points improvement in loss ratios. For details, visit pibit.ai.
long_description.after:
Pibit is the AI Underwriting OS for Commercial, Specialty & E&S insurance. Its AI agents run underwriting from submission to quote: they check submissions for completeness and chase brokers for what's missing, clear appetite, ingest documents and third-party data, analyze against guidelines, and give underwriters a risk summary with risk signals, pricing scenarios and benchmarks. Underwriters spend their time only on decisions and broker relationships.

50+ carriers and MGAs across 10+ lines run on Pibit. We guarantee 99.9% workflow accuracy in the contract from day one, go live one module at a time in weeks, and have never had a failed implementation. Pricing is per submission processed, with no license or implementation fee. Based in the Bay Area, with R&D in Bangalore.

one_liner.before: The fastest path from submission to better decisions.
one_liner.after: The AI Underwriting OS for Commercial, Specialty & E&S insurance

long_description.before:
WeReno helps property owners plan and execute renovations and capital projects. We combine technology with hands-on project management, contractor sourcing, and owner's representation to deliver complex projects more efficiently.

Founded in 2022 and backed by Y Combinator (W22), we've facilitated over $1B in renovations and capital projects across residential, commercial, and hospitality properties.

Our platform simplifies the entire renovation lifecycle, from initial planning and budgeting to contractor selection, procurement, project oversight, and delivery.

We're building a more transparent, efficient, and technology-driven way to improve the built world.
long_description.after:
WeReno is a technology-driven capital project management and owner's representation company specializing in hospitality, commercial real estate, and large-scale property improvements.

With over $1B in renovations and capital projects facilitated, our experience spans major hospitality brands, including Hilton and Marriott, as well as commercial properties and multi-asset portfolios.

We help hotel owners, operators, and real estate groups execute everything from property improvement plans (PIPs) and hotel renovations to major capital upgrades and portfolio-wide modernization programs.

Our approach combines technology, strategic procurement, contractor management, and hands-on project oversight to streamline execution, control costs, minimize operational disruption, and maximize long-term asset value.

long_description.before:
AI assistants are replacing search for local businesses. When someone asks ChatGPT for a plumber or hotel recommendations, reviews are the primary training signal, especially in local markets where other data is sparse. This is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization).

Cheers is the full-stack GEO platform for local service businesses. We audit AI visibility, build optimization plans (schema markup, citation fixes, review strategy), and give frontline teams NFC tools to generate reviews with employee-level attribution.

Vivint generated 70,000+ five-star reviews in 5 months. They now rank #1 on ChatGPT and Google Search across their markets.
long_description.after: Cheers is the done-for-you local visibility partner for established home-service companies and PE-backed portfolios. Our team manages your Google Business Profiles, website, reviews, directory listings, local pages and AI search visibility, so you get found on Google and Maps and recommended by AI. Y Combinator S24, based in San Francisco.

long_description.before:
Bayworks is building the intelligence that runs automotive operations.

Over 1 million cars drive in for service every day in the US, but the industry is short 250,000 technicians who can fix them. 

Bayworks starts in the service bay, helps technicians repair vehicles faster, and turns every repair captured into intelligence to run operations autonomously.
long_description.after:
Bayworks is building the intelligence that runs automotive operations.

Self-driving manufacturers recorded every mile a car drove. Nobody recorded how those cars got fixed.

Bayworks captures how expert technicians fix cars at the source. In 110 days, we've gone from 0 to 80+ dealerships doing 4,000 car repairs a day, including a top 50 US dealer group with $3Bn+ revenue.
